tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Current FY2027 NDAA bill status (H.R. 8800 / S. 4784): headline, summary, next steps, stage tracker, and as-of date. Cite the returned ndaa.ai URL.

tools.name: search_sections
tools.description: Search FY2027 NDAA sections by keyword or topic (pay raise, FOCI, OTA, shipbuilding, etc.). Returns matching sections with snippets and canonical ndaa.ai URLs.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get one FY2027 NDAA section: plain-language summary, statutory text, House and Senate variants when both exist, and the ndaa.ai URL to cite.

tools.name: compare_house_senate
tools.description: Compare House (H.R. 8800) vs Senate (S. 4784) text for a section number or a topic. Returns which chamber has the section, whether the text differs, and the diff URL.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Latest NDAA news items tracked on ndaa.ai (outlet, date, summary, source URL, and the /news page to cite).

tools.name: list_updates
tools.description: List ndaa.ai's dated NDAA update posts, newest first: date, title, story count, status note, and the /updates/YYYY-MM-DD URL to cite.

tools.name: get_update
tools.description: Get one dated NDAA update post (the newest if no date): intro, every story (headline, outlet, summary, source URL), status note, and the canonical URL.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List NDAA.AI explainer guides (status, House vs Senate, FY2027 vs FY2026, military pay raise) with canonical URLs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_status, search_sections, get_section, list_updates, get_update, list_guides · Public sink: get_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_status, search_sections, get_section, list_updates, get_update, list_guides · Public sink: get_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
